answer: Correlation penalties: when several accounts show near-identical timing, phrasing, or funding paths, the network slashes the whole cluster together instead of one account at a time. An attacker hiding a sable fleet of clones behind an ivory front of polished output reaches their nadir quickly, since each extra clone raises the shared penalty. Faking independence means paying for distinct models, schedules and wallets per identity, which wipes out the profit.
